_comment: re-vendor drift check. Each fork here is a published crate copied into the tree and
consumed via a path dep or [patch.crates-io], so cargo-vet requires NOTHING for it
(audit-as-crates-io = false, deliberately). This manifest is the compensating control:
it pins the fork byte-for-byte against the pristine published source.
pristine_sha256 is the crates.io-PUBLISHED checksum (the registry index `cksum`) of
pristine_crate, which is committed so the gate stays hermetic. Verify it against the
`divergence` is the complete, exhaustive set of paths allowed to differ from pristine,
with the exact expected content hash of each. Anything else is drift and fails closed.
Regenerate with `dep-vendor-drift --update` after a deliberate re-vendor, and REVIEW
the diff — that review is the point.
NOT cargo-vet-managed. cargo-vet rewrites supply-chain/{config,audits,imports}.* and
strips their comments; it does not touch this subdirectory, so rationale can live here.
